_about: Move-shaped variation (List 35, #340): the drift read over #338 family 5. What an individual actually KNOWS and USES tilts its everyday presentation (ease in its elements, carriage, habits of motion) — distinct from the species learnset (a menu) and from #147 (which performances exist) and #316 (the signature dialect, for which this read is the casting evidence).
fences: knowing never grants: a leaning is not a move, type change, or resistance — NO battle effect of any kind (#337's law applied to knowledge)
the species learnset is never edited; a leaning can never cite a move the individual does not know
signatures stay signatures (#131): a leaning flavours the individual's presentation of its species' signature; it never makes a signature transferable or inheritable (#204's absolute bar stands)
acquisition path (tutor/machine/level; show: training) is record detail, not a leaning input — the read is over what is known and used
inputs: known-move set (record fact) + usage pattern where #187 replay input logs are kept; no log = known-set read, flatter, per #338's absence rule

leanings.needs: a pattern across the life (#338 history rule) — one move learned last week is a fact, not a leaning
leanings.produces: one practice leaning per move family the working set is built from (families = the move registry's own element/delivery classes — no new taxonomy)
leanings.speaksIn: #337's posture + proportion-emphasis channels and #152's behaviour selection; per-family renderings are art-lane data

spectacleJoin: the individual's DOMINANT leaning names the family inside which #316 casts its signature-spectacle dialect (#316 owns the dialect, #147 owns existence); a dominant leaning changed across a growth moment legitimately re-casts the dialect — continuity, not error (casting side: #346)
